description.describe_ch: 管理學是一門兼具科學與藝術的統整性學科。其目的在培養學生成為具備國際觀、前瞻性和競爭力的經理人。課程重視管理知識的傳授和管理能力的培養。課程實施側重於實務導向。從核心概念的建立，逐步導入國內外企業管理實務，強調整合性思考和實務應用。
description.describe_eh: Management is both a science and an art. The purpose of this course is to prepare students to be future managers with global vision and the ability to compete in this fast-paced world. The course focuses on foundational management theory education and managerial competence creation. the class emphasis is on business practice orientation. Beginning with core concepts, then learning through practice cases.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠用自己的詞彙定義何謂管理學；能夠描述企業的外在環境因素；能夠描述管理程序
targets.describe_en: The comprehension of Defining Management with their own words；be able to describe business external environment factors；be able to describe management process.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解外在環境因素對企業的影響和衝擊;瞭解管理功能的內涵和彼此之相關性
targets.describe_en: The knowledge of how the external environment affects business and Understand the management function and their relationship.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠說明並比較各種管理理論之特性；掌握新的管理發展趨勢並應用在企業實務
targets.describe_en: The comprehension of how to explain and compare the characters among different management theories. Catch the new management trend and apply to business practice.

targets.describe_ch: 闡述企業如何將企業倫理和社會責任以及環保等重要議題，融入經營管理決策，強化企業永續經營理念
targets.describe_en: The comprehension of how business to combine the business ethic and social responsibility and environment issue into decision making. Make business sustainable growth.
